commands.name: Hermes Ops Cockpit
commands.description: iMac native cmux workspace for MBP Hermes runtime monitoring via SSH/tmux plus local vault/docs surfaces.
commands.command: ssh openclaw@100.95.209.3 'tmux attach -t mission-hermes || tmux new -s mission-hermes'

commands.name: OpenClaw Ops Cockpit
commands.description: iMac native cmux workspace for MBP OpenClaw runtime monitoring via SSH/tmux plus local project/browser surfaces.
commands.command: ssh openclaw@100.95.209.3 'tmux attach -t mission-openclaw || tmux new -s mission-openclaw'

commands.name: Code Workbench
commands.description: Open the Hermes CLI cockpit repo with repo-aware commands; add native browser/file/vault panes from cmux UI.
commands.command: cd /Users/openclaw/Code/hermes-cli-cockpit && pwd && git status --short --branch && bin/cockpit-workspaces list && echo 'Use cmux split/browser/file panels from here.'

commands.name: Agent Deck
commands.description: Agent/worktree inventory for orchestration; starts read-only until agent-deck is installed.
commands.command: cd /Users/openclaw/Code/hermes-cli-cockpit && bin/cockpit-workspaces inventory agent-deck && echo 'Next: create worktrees and launch Codex/Claude/OpenCode in native cmux surfaces.'

commands.name: Obsidian Vault
commands.description: Open canonical Hermes workspace/vault path from a native cmux terminal surface.
commands.command: cd /Users/openclaw/.hermes/workspace && pwd && printf 'Vault root ready. Open Finder/file panel/browser/Obsidian surface from cmux.\n'
